name: Óscar Washington Tabárez
scopeNote: Counted: Uruguay national team 2006-2021 (World Cup 2010 semi-final/4th, Copa América 2011 title, four World Cups, 'proceso' of youth structure). Start 2006-03-06 and end 2021-11-19 come from ESPN Deportes via search summary (page not mined), consistent with The Clinic/El Observador pieces dated 2021-11-19 calling him 'exentrenador'. Sources describe a 4-4-2 (1-4-4-2) base with a compact block in two lines of four, flexible shape (diamond, back three, 4-3-1-2), reactive 'play according to the opponent' approach, strong set pieces; 'Garra Charrúa' is the cultural label. Marking: only a stated rejection of individual (man) marking of Messi (2021); no source describes the corner marking scheme. Other spells excluded (see spellsExcluded; their dates are year-only because no day was read, from search summaries); data on those is not evidence here.
openQuestions: Spell dates 2006-03-06 and 2021-11-19 taken from a search summary of ESPN Deportes (not mined); confirm the exact days with a read page.

Peñarol 1987 (Copa Libertadores) is a major title and could be counted; not researched here (no tactical sources mined, budget). Decide if the caller wants it added. Dates of excluded spells are from memory/search summaries, years only.
El Gráfico interview 'En primera persona' is dated 2011 per search summary; the page shows 2021-11-19 (republication). Date of original interview should be confirmed.
Quotes from El Observador frases article are press-reported (attributed); original dates 2012-09 (Argentina 3-0) and 2014-06-24 are inferred from article context and need confirmation.
build-up and marking of corners (zonal vs man) not documented in any read source; Vavel 2015 '4-4-2 duro y con mucha presión' returned 403.
Squad-building signal: the data shows few debuts 2010-14 (7) and many after 2018 (21 in three years); critics in 2012 said he always called the same players.

statedView.quote: Uruguay tiene que jugar en función del rival. Nosotros nos sentimos bien haciéndolo. Nos sentimos muy fuertes en eso de tratar de limitarlo y después crearle problemas
A LA MANERA IDEAL que un entrenador quisiera ver jugar a su equipo, yo la llamo estrategia de juego. (...) La táctica aparece cuando hay un rival enfrente.
Marca individual no, pobre el que tenga que hacer eso. Algunos equipos lo han intentado alguna vez

El éxito no son solo los resultados sino las dificultades que se pasan para obtenerlos, la lucha permanente, el espíritu de plantearse desafíos y la valentía para superarlos. El camino es la recompensa.
Esto es un mundial de fútbol, no de moralidad barata
Como dijo alguna vez algún entrenador, hay que cerrar los esfínteres, todos, principalmente la boca.

We have worked hard at youth level and we only have a little over three million inhabitants. When you produce one great player in Uruguay, that’s equal to 20 in Brazil and 10 in Argentina. Therefore, we have had to approach the game differently compared to everyone else.
Nos habían estudiado muy bien, evidentemente. Conozco a (Gustavo) Alfaro, es un gran entrenador, esos detalles no se le van
